title: Credits
content: German Basic was developed by the Language Centre, University of Cambridge.
Images: created with an AI image generator (OpenAI ChatGPT) from prompts written and selected by the course team.
Voices: the audio is synthetic speech from Microsoft Azure AI Speech neural voices. It is planned to be replaced by recordings of human speakers.
Text: the lessons were written and checked by the course team. A large language model (LLM) was used to help draft and check some of the material.
